annotations.title: How often the experts are right

description: How often TipMaster players got football (soccer) matches right, per group (Top 20%, Top 25%, All players): majorityCorrect is the share of matches where the group’s most common home/draw/away call was right, outcomeCorrect the share of individual predictions with the right outcome, exactCorrect the share with the exact final score (National only). National covers the last 8 weeks, each week’s groups ranked on the 8 weeks before it; Classic covers this season, ranked by career record since 1997, and career gives each group’s average career points per match since 1997. A group’s rates appear once it has 50 matches with a published split (reason too_few_matches until then). Pass competition (National league name) or game (Classic) to narrow it.

game.description: Classic game: btm = Bundesliga TipMaster, tmi = TipMaster International

mode.description: national (exact scores, 15 countries) or classic (home/draw/away, 25 matches a week); omit for both.
